name: 10127-prefixreuse-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- an ungated re-upload of `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` under the Llama 3.1 Community License: same weights, same config.json shape fields. bf16, 15.0 GiB.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 640 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: a shared preamble of 2048 tokens drawn from a pool of 64, emitted as guidellm's own `prefix` column so it is prepended, plus a unique query of ~1024 tokens (stdev 128, clamped 512-1536), generating ~512 tokens (stdev 64, clamped 256-768). ~3072 tokens in. Seed 42.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant answering long document questions from 16 concurrent users on one GPU, sharing standard preambles.
launch:
# sglang server args at commit cdc56ef6c1c6f359de87c5f78a66316723557d5d
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.5.2rc2-102-gcdc56ef6c1c).

# Ungated re-upload of the gated `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`; same weights, same shapes.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
context-length: 8192
page-size: 32

# The engine takes the SMALLER of the profiled pool and this cap and only logs a warning: check
# `max_total_num_tokens` on startup reads 131072, and raise mem-fraction-static, not the cap.
mem-fraction-static: 0.80
max-total-tokens: 131072

# The host tier must exceed the GPU tier; the engine asserts it on startup.
enable-hierarchical-cache: true
hicache-size: 40
hicache-write-policy: write_through
hicache-io-backend: kernel

random-seed: 42
